evidence: Labeled IPC; introduces `interfaces::Snapshot` in `src/interfaces/snapshot.h` and adds snapshot loading methods to `interfaces::Node`.
rationale: Exposes assumeutxo snapshot loading through the node interface abstraction to allow GUI and multiprocess consumers to load snapshots and receive progress notifications. It directly unblocks downstream GUI implementations in bitcoin-core/gui#870 and bitcoin-core/gui-qml#488.
